1 .  Criteria 
 
Product Name:Epinephrine Pens (Non-Mylan Manufacturer)*, Neffy  
Approval Length 
6 month(s)  
Guideline Type 
Prior Authorization  
 
 
Approval Criteria    
 
1 - There is a shortage on Epinephrine Pens manufactured by Mylan.  
Notes  
*Only approve other rebatable epinephrine autoinjectors if both the br
anded EpiPen and authorized generic are on the FDA shortage list.
